review_input.original_instruction: We're going to start in a bathroom facing some sinks. We're going to turn to the left, to where we'll have bathroom stalls to your left. We're going to walk towards and out the door. Once out the door, we're going to hang a right in the hallway with tile and wood paneling. When you get to the door in the hallway, it will have a sconce on either side and with a drinking fountain to the right. Turn to the left and go into the main room which has a table in the center and various benches. We're going to walk to the left into this main room, to where you'll have some stairs to your right, a door, and a ficus tree on the left. Continue walking forward, until you are next to a table covered in a white table clothe, and over by the large fire place with a heavy wooden mantle on  your left. Turn to your right and go into the humidor area. You'll have a cabinet with some cigars and a leather bench. Walk forward towards the exit, but don't go through it. Instead, hang a right. Through the doorway, by the exit, is going to be a tufted upholstered chair and some champagne flutes, as well as a bathroom. Go into this room and hang a right. From here you will see the bathroom in front of you, a mirror and vanity to your right, as well as another mirror in front of you. And this is where we will stop.
